feature: Blame anchor triage (P30) + investigation coverage improvements (P31)
problem: GROOVY-7014 at rank 8 just misses the 7-slot triage window. HIVE-4113 not examined by LLM (exam_recall=false). IGNITE-6748/SPARK-23059 examined but ranked poorly.
proposed_solution: P30: Add BLAME_ANCHOR_SLOTS=1 — scan positions 8+ for localization_blame candidates, add at most 1 extra watchlist entry. P31: Strengthen Phase 2/2b prompts with mandatory full-coverage examination + comparative analysis step. Bump Phase 2b budget 8→10 tool calls, 4→5 turns.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: triage.py defines BLAME_ANCHOR_SLOTS=1 and _has_blame_signal() helper
AC2: assign_tiers() accepts blame_anchor_slots parameter with default=1
AC3: Blame anchor scans shortlist positions beyond standard window (must_examine_size + watchlist_size) for localization_blame candidates
AC4: At most blame_anchor_slots extra candidates added to watchlist (not must_examine)
AC5: blame_anchor_slots=0 disables anchoring entirely (no extra candidates)
AC6: Blame-anchored candidates get 'blame-anchored' in rationale string
AC7: pipeline.py narrow_candidates() passes blame_anchor_slots through to assign_tiers()
AC8: Phase 2 prompt contains 'MUST call get_commit_diff on EVERY must-examine commit' and 'Do NOT skip any'
AC9: Phase 2b prompt contains 'MUST call get_commit_diff on EVERY watchlist commit' and 'Do NOT skip any'
AC10: Both Phase 2 and Phase 2b prompts include comparative analysis step (compare evidence, timing, causal links)
AC11: Phase 2b budget is PHASE2B_MAX_TOOL_CALLS=10, PHASE2B_MAX_TURNS=5
AC12: All tests pass (349/349), zero linter errors
edge_cases: EC1: No blame candidates outside standard window → watchlist stays at 4 (no anchor fires)
EC2: Blame candidates already inside top 7 → no redundant anchoring
EC3: Shortlist smaller than standard window → no index error, blame anchor scan is safe
EC4: Multiple blame candidates outside window with blame_anchor_slots=1 → only first (highest-ranked) gets anchored
verification_method: Read triage.py, pipeline.py, prompts.py, watchlist_expansion.py. Verify each AC by code inspection. Run grep for key strings in prompts. Run pytest to confirm 349/349. Check that blame anchor tier_rank continues sequence from standard watchlist.
